tasks.label: Kill SSH/Git
tasks.command: taskkill /F /IM ssh.exe 2>nul & taskkill /F /IM git.exe 2>nul & echo done

tasks.label: clean-ssh
args: taskkill /F /IM ssh.exe 2>nul & taskkill /F /IM git.exe 2>nul & echo cleaned

tasks.label: build-dev-image
tasks.command: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Set-Location 'd:\pallastrade\pallastrade'; docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml build 2>&1"

tasks.label: Docker Status Check
tasks.command: docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}' 2>&1; echo '---'; docker images pallastrade-web --format '{{.CreatedAt}}' 2>&1
